statusText.COMPLETED: The entry page was inspected in every run.
statusText.PARTIAL: The total time ran out before finishing: the report covers only what was visited.
statusText.BLOCKED: The site blocked the inspection (anti-bot, CAPTCHA, login or 451). EXEGEZIS does not try to get past that block.
statusText.UNREACHABLE: The site could not be reached (DNS, TLS or connection).
statusText.TIMEOUT: The entry page did not finish loading in time.
statusText.ENGINE_ERROR: The browser could not start on this computer. The problem is on this computer, not on the site: no conclusion was drawn about it.

title.noLang: The html element has no lang attribute
title.noViewport: The page has no meta viewport
title.contrast: Text {fgName} {fg} on {bgName} {bg}: contrast {ratio}:1, minimum {required}:1{large, select, yes { (large text)} other {}}
title.mobileScroll: The page scrolls sideways on a small screen
title.mobileText: Text under 12 px in {count, plural, one {# place} other {# places}}
title.mobileNoViewport: No meta viewport: phones show the desktop page shrunk
title.mobileZoom: The meta viewport keeps people from zooming
title.mobileFixed: Fixed elements cover {percent} % of the screen
title.tapSize: {shape, select, both {of {width}×{height} px} tall {{height} px tall} other {{width} px wide}}

groupVerdict.MIXED: some elements only in some runs

group.counts: {elements, plural, one {# element} other {# elements}} · {pages, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}}
group.mixed: {verified} of {elements} elements appear in every run; {intermittent} only in some. The intermittent ones are marked in each example and in the per-element view.
group.current: Current: {fg} on {bg} · {ratio}:1 (minimum {required}:1{large, select, yes {, large text} other {}})
group.suggestionHelp: The suggestion is the closest colour that meets the minimum by changing only the lightness (same hue and saturation). It is calculated, not checked on the page: review it in your design.
group.specs: {count, plural, one {# Playwright spec} other {# Playwright specs}}, one per verified element
group.shotAltMarked: Screenshot of {page} with the affected elements marked
group.tapSuggestion: Suggestion: make them at least 24×24 px, for example with padding: {y} px {x} px, or leave at least 24 px between the centre of each one and its neighbour's (WCAG 2.2, 2.5.8).
group.globalHelp: It appears on every inspected page: most likely a shared template (menu, header or footer), fixed in one place.

list.title: Inspections
list.description: Read-only reviews of a website with deterministic checks. A finding is verified only if it appears in every run.
list.noneBody: Start one from the home page, or run <command></command> in a terminal.
list.problems: {problems, plural, one {# problem} other {# problems}} · {elements, plural, one {# element} other {# elements}}

detail.invalidBody: The report does not meet its schema, or its verdicts and counts do not derive from the recorded observations. It is not shown, not even in part.
detail.noBrowser: No browser could start on this computer, so no page was visited and there are no findings: no conclusion was drawn about {origin}.
detail.writes: The page made {count, plural, one {# write} other {# writes}} on its own
detail.writesDegraded: The affected pages are marked degraded and their findings are discarded ({count} observations).
detail.writesAllowed: The page sent {count, plural, one {# request} other {# requests}} on its own while loading (statistics, players…): they were allowed and are listed. The inspection does not submit forms or press buttons. If they must not reach the server, repeat with «Strict read-only» checked.
detail.verifiedHint: {elements, plural, one {# element} other {# elements}} on {pages, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}}
detail.intermittentHint: {count, plural, one {# element} other {# elements}}, apart, no spec
detail.info: {count} informational (basic SEO), not counted as problems
detail.problemsSubtitle: grouped by what needs fixing, from highest to lowest impact
detail.findingsSubtitle: one finding per element and page, present in {runs}/{runs} runs
detail.notInspected: No findings: it could not be inspected
detail.noVerifiedBody: No check found a problem in every run. This does not mean the site has no bugs: generic checks do not detect logic errors.
detail.intermittentSubtitle: observed only in some runs; not verified
detail.noIntermittent: None: everything observed appeared in every run or in none.
detail.pageWritesSubtitle: non-GET requests sent by the page itself
detail.noWrites: The page made no write request during the inspection.
detail.budgetValue: {pages, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} · depth {depth} · {runs, plural, one {# run} other {# runs}}
detail.accessStored: Stored encrypted on this computer; its content is not recorded.
detail.traceDropped: The trace was not kept because it could not be redacted.
detail.rateLimitValue: {count, plural, one {# wait} other {# waits}} ({seconds} s in total)
detail.notRecorded: not recorded (report older than this field)
detail.systemBrowser: Installed on the system: not Playwright's Chromium.
detail.skippedSubtitle: they look like signing out or deleting something: never visited

repro.open: Open {page} in a fresh browser context (no cookies, no cache).
repro.wait: Wait until the network is idle and the DOM stops changing.

detail.noSpecIntermittent: No spec: only verified findings are compiled.
detail.noSpecAssertion: No spec: this finding's check cannot be expressed as an assertion.
detail.specMissing: The report cites {path}, but the file does not exist.
detail.specHelp: It fails while the problem exists and passes once it is fixed. Use BASE_URL to point it at another environment.

delete.label: Delete the inspection {id}
delete.confirm: Delete this inspection? It cannot be undone.
delete.running: It is still running: wait for it to finish.
delete.failed: It could not be deleted. Reload the page and try again.
